title: FreeCAD explicit-entity route and SubDMesh peer refresh
evidenceKind: primary-source review plus existing local consumer observation

method.evidenceRule: Documentation, source routes, and runtime outcomes are separate evidence. A generic importer fallback, entity count, or peer changelog entry does not establish semantic correctness or a libdxfrw defect.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD documentation lists 3DFACE only for its optional legacy importer and does not list MESH; it says embedded ACIS/SAT solids cannot be read. Current C++ importer source contains a generic-shape fallback for built geometry, but that alone does not establish which entity callbacks are accepted end-to-end. The existing FreeCAD 1.1.3 macOS observation records mixed outcomes: both libdxfrw- and ODA-produced DXFs yielded the same total imported-object count, but the importer reported 38 3DFACE, 69 SOLID, and 22 HATCH entities unsupported and logged entity-read exceptions.
evidence.planUse: Keep C++ 3DFACE/MESH as NOT_DOCUMENTED until exact runtime qualification. Treat the installed-build observation as partial and sample-bound. Future consumer rows must map each source entity to imported shape/topology, unsupported, skipped, or errored outcomes; aggregate object totals are insufficient.

evidence.observed: The third-party FreeCAD addon is present in FreeCAD's addon catalog and describes ExchangerConv conversion through an intermediate BREP. CAD Exchanger documents DWG/DXF and SAT/SAB format support, but its current FreeCAD page says FreeCAD is not supported yet. The converter/application is commercial and the addon is not part of stock FreeCAD.
evidence.planUse: Classify as an optional THIRD_PARTY_COMMERCIAL_INTEGRATION_CANDIDATE. A run requires an already-authorized installation and pinned addon commit, converter version/hash, OS, command, BREP hash, and FreeCAD result. No installation, purchase, or trial is implied; no stock-FreeCAD, AcDs-association, or independent-kernel claim follows.

evidence.route: LibreDWG SubDMesh and security regression prompts
evidence.observed: LibreDWG NEWS records a DXF SubDMesh binary-import fix (GH #272) and recent 3DSOLID block-size arithmetic hardening. These are peer change notes, not local defect evidence.
evidence.planUse: Retain the existing generated AC1027 ASCII/Binary MESH round-trip controls as the fast local owner. Do not add fixtures, dependencies, a peer run, or a test registration solely to mirror the peer fixes. Check local size/index boundaries separately from DWG class support and subdivision rendering.

implementationReadiness: Keep documentation, current source inspection, and installed runtime evidence in separate S8 columns.
For each consumer claim, bind source entity handles/types to converter output and record imported shape type, topology, bounds/units, unsupported/skipped/error outcome, and warnings.
For DWG consumer paths, record converter binary/arguments/exit status and fresh intermediate DXF hash/$ACADVER, then identify FreeCAD build, importer backend, and settings.
Treat the CADExchanger addon as an optional commercially licensed route only; it cannot qualify the stock dwg2dxf-to-FreeCAD route or AcDs owner/key closure.
Continue with the existing focused CTests; this research adds no full-suite run, fixture, dependency, or production change.
limitations: This was not a new FreeCAD or LibreDWG runtime execution.
FreeCAD's current code and mutable addon catalog must be pinned before any future runtime qualification.
The existing consumer observation is one host/build/sample and does not establish general entity support.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
